Make clai2 /compact shrink a history just over its protected tail, and report honest savings

/compact protected the newest protected_tokens (50,000 by default) even when the
conversation was barely larger. The summarizer then replaced only the first
message with a summary plus that same first prompt, so 186 messages became 187
and the report said 0 tokens saved.

/compact now protects at most half the conversation, and commits the result only
when it is smaller, reporting the estimated tokens saved out of the total.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Make `clai2` `/compact` shrink a history just over its protected tail, and report honest savings

`/compact` could make the conversation bigger. One report read `Compacted 186 messages down to 187; about 0 tokens saved.`

### Cause

`/compact` runs the plugin's chain with `keep_tokens=protected_tokens` (50,000 by default). When the history is only a little over 50,000 estimated tokens, harness `find_token_cutoff` places the cut at message 1. `SummarizingCompaction` then summarizes only the first request and also keeps that first user prompt verbatim (`preserve_first_user_message`). The result is a summary, the same first prompt, and the 185 untouched messages: 187 messages and more tokens than before. The plugin committed any result that differed from the input, and clamped negative savings to 0. A history of one prompt, 92 tool rounds, and a final answer at 50,127 estimated tokens reproduces it exactly.

### Changes

- `/compact` protects `min(protected_tokens, half the history's estimated tokens)`, so it always has an older half to summarize or drop. Automatic compaction keeps the full `protected_tokens` tail; its trigger and chain are unchanged.
- `/compact` commits the result only when it has fewer estimated tokens. Otherwise it keeps the history and says `Nothing to compact: compacting would not make the conversation smaller.` This covers a summary longer than what it replaces. It also covers an empty or one-message history, which never reaches the summarizer. The old "the last 50,000 tokens are always kept" message is gone, because `/compact` no longer leaves a history unchanged just because it fits in the tail.
- The report gives savings against the total: `Compacted 186 messages down to 95; about 24,976 of 50,127 tokens saved.`
- The `protected_tokens` description, the README's "Compacting the conversation" section, and the `PLUGINS.md` `compaction` paragraph describe the cap and the no-shrink case.

No setting, stored value, or schema changes.

### Verification

- New `test_compact_shrinks_a_history_just_over_the_protected_tail` (summarization and truncation) uses the 186-message, 50,127-token history. It fails on `main` (186 → 187) and passes here: under 100 messages, about half the tokens saved, and an exact report. New `test_compact_keeps_the_history_when_the_summary_is_no_smaller` checks that an oversized summary is discarded and the history is left as it was. Existing tests now use replies long enough for a summary to be smaller.
- `tests/clai2`: 3454 passed and 4 skipped under `-n auto`. Four subprocess startup tests timed out at 15 s on a cold local `.venv` and passed on rerun. Branch coverage of `builtin_plugins/compaction.py` is 100%.
- `ruff format --check`, `ruff check`, and `pyright` on the changed files are clean.
- tmux, `uv run clai2 -m test` with an isolated `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`: `/compact keep the detail` printed `Compacted 8 messages down to 4; about 31,001 of 41,409 tokens saved.`

### Checklist

- [x] No **breaking changes** in accordance with the [version policy](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/blob/main/docs/version-policy.md).
- [x] **PR title** is fit for the [release changelog](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/releases).

Prepared with Claude Opus 5.5.
